record.title: DCM or SEF · derivatives-specific pathways
kv: The contract and execution function bring the venue within DCM or SEF requirements.
Chicago Mercantile Exchange, Inc. (registered or chartered); Cboe Futures Exchange, LLC (registered or chartered); Bloomberg SEF LLC (registered or chartered); Cboe SEF, LLC (registered or chartered)
Designated contract markets or registered swap execution facilities under their respective statutory routes
Choose the correct statutory pathway. Recover the specific designation/registration and permissions. Apply participant and product rules.
DCM and SEF are different tests; this is a research branch, not an entity authorization.

Chicago Mercantile Exchange, Inc.: CFTC's list header reads 'Pending - Provisional Registration'; its remarks state that CME Inc. was provisionally registered on November 20, 2012 and identify interest-rate, credit, foreign-exchange, equity, and other-commodity asset classes.
Cboe Futures Exchange, LLC: CFTC's designated-contract-market registry lists Cboe Futures Exchange, LLC as designated and records the current name effective October 31, 2017.
Bloomberg SEF LLC: CFTC's registered-SEF registry lists Bloomberg SEF LLC as registered.
Cboe SEF, LLC: CFTC's registered-SEF registry lists Cboe SEF, LLC as registered and records its prior-name history.
Chicago Mercantile Exchange, Inc.: CFTC-designated contract market. CFTC's current DCM registry identifies Chicago Mercantile Exchange, Inc. as designated.
Cboe Futures Exchange, LLC: CFTC-designated contract market. CFTC's current DCM registry identifies Cboe Futures Exchange, LLC as designated.
Bloomberg SEF LLC: CFTC-registered swap execution facility. CFTC's current SEF registry identifies Bloomberg SEF LLC as registered.
Cboe SEF, LLC: CFTC-registered swap execution facility. CFTC's current SEF registry identifies Cboe SEF, LLC as registered.
